config.label: Solana wallet private key in base58 format
config.description: Solana wallet private key in base58 format. Required for auto-signing transactions and WebSocket authentication.

config.label: Solana RPC endpoint URL
config.description: Solana RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com if not set.

config.label: TradeRouter server public key (base58) used to verify server signatures
config.description: TradeRouter server public key (base58) used to verify server signatures. Defaults to the hardcoded trust anchor.

config.label: Optional next/rotated TradeRouter server public key (base58) for key rotation support
config.description: Optional next/rotated TradeRouter server public key (base58) for key rotation support.

config.label: Whether to require server signature verification on filled orders
config.description: Whether to require server signature verification on filled orders. Defaults to true.

config.label: Whether to require server signature verification on order creation
config.description: Whether to require server signature verification on order creation. Defaults to true.
